Priya Nair: quick heads-up — LumenWell reported slow responses during onboarding demo last night. customer saw p95 latency ~1.8s vs SLO 1.0s. tagging eng and SE to confirm impact and whether a credit is warranted.

sla-bot: Automated alert for customer=LumenWell: 30d uptime=99.84%, p95_latency=1.82s, window=2025-11-02T22:00:00Z..2025-11-03T04:00:00Z :warning:

Ben Liu: we're on it. saw a spike tied to the dedicated pool autoscaler failing to spin up under burst. scaled manually at 22:12 UTC, fixed by 22:18.

Asha Patel: do we have request counts / impacted percentage? need that to compute credit and for the customer note.

Ben Liu: quick numbers from logs: total requests in window=18,240; requests over SLO threshold=920 (~5.0%). majority were short-lived scaleups hitting cold-model paths.

Priya Nair: thanks. rough credit calc per SLA: credit proportional to downtime-equivalent. can someone draft the calc? customer expects a short PDF + numbers.

Ben Liu: draft calc pasted below — please sanity-check:
```
SLA_credit_pct = min(1, (SLO_threshold_breach_ratio - 0.01) / 0.2)
where SLO_threshold_breach_ratio = 0.05 (5%)
=> SLA_credit_pct = (0.05 - 0.01) / 0.2 = 0.20 => 20% of monthly usage for affected product route
```
Ben Liu: note: that's conservative and matches our standard credit ladder.

Carlos Mendez: hmm 20% could be material at renewal. Customer is in Q4 renewal window. can we offer an alternative? 2 months discounted Dedicated rate + a post-mortem might be cleaner for them.

Asha Patel: agree we should give them options. I'll prep two one-pagers: (A) formal SLA credit calc + breakdown, (B) goodwill offer (discount + onboarding credits) and include mitigations we implemented (autoscaler healthcheck, warm pool config).

Priya Nair: action items: Ben — confirm precise time range and attach kg logs; Asha — draft both one-pagers; Carlos — propose a renewal conversation script offering option A or B; I'll coordinate customer email and request signatures for acceptance. propose 30m sync tomorrow 10:00 PT.

Carlos Mendez: 10:00 PT works for me. @Priya Nair pls include customer outcomes we want (retain, move to Dedicated commit). :thumbsup:

Ben Liu: attaching quick grep snippet I'll use to pull exact requests (will paste into the doc):
```bash
grep "lumenwell" /var/log/inference/*.log | awk '$4 >= "2025-11-02T22:00:00" && $4 <= "2025-11-03T04:00:00"' | wc -l
```

sla-bot: Incident note created: INC-2025-3275, severity=low, reporter=Ben Liu, status=triaged.

Priya Nair: perfect — I'll draft the cover email and share a first pass by EOD. thanks all :pray:

Asha Patel: will upload the one-pagers to the shared drive and link in the thread before the sync.

Carlos Mendez: added: if they take the goodwill path, include a free enablement session (2 hrs) and a migration checklist to reduce risk.

Priya Nair: noted. last_message_ts set after sync invite.

Ben Liu: closing loop on fix — I've pushed autoscaler health checks to staging and will prod to prod after sign-off. :white_check_mark:
